nfk2050-arterial.label: On an arterial or collector street, in a Sustain place type
nfk2050-arterial.source: NFK2050 Comprehensive Plan, adopted December 9, 2025 (Ordinance No. 50201)
nfk2050-arterial.quote: The Secondary, non-residential uses envisioned for the Sustain areas are appropriate primarily along arterials and collector streets, preserving the residential character of the neighborhood interiors.
nfk2050-arterial.how: The parcel lies in NFK2050's Sustain – Traditional place type and comes within 45 ft of a street the City's centerline layer classes as an arterial or collector.

nfk2050-innovation.label: In NFK2050's Innovation and Production place type (the medical campus)
nfk2050-innovation.source: NFK2050 Comprehensive Plan, adopted December 9, 2025 (Ordinance No. 50201)
nfk2050-innovation.quote: Residential uses may be included in mixed-use or live/work configurations, but ground floors should be accessible and active from the street.
nfk2050-innovation.how: The plan lists commercial/retail as a secondary use here and asks for supporting amenities, food and retail among them (p. 80).

nfk2050-activity.label: In NFK2050's Regional Activity Center place type
nfk2050-activity.source: NFK2050 Comprehensive Plan, adopted December 9, 2025 (Ordinance No. 50201)
nfk2050-activity.quote: Regional Activity Centers integrate residential, commercial, and cultural uses, creating a lively and dynamic urban environment.
nfk2050-activity.how: The plan's chart lists commercial/retail among the place type's uses.

corner.label: A corner lot in HC-G2 (the campaign's addition)
corner.source: Ghent Streets' parcel explorer: the lot's edge comes within 45 ft of two differently named streets that meet within 120 ft of it
corner.quote: Small-scale retail or other complementary community-facing uses are encouraged at key nodes or intersections, with consistent street frontage.
corner.how: The campaign reads NFK2050's "key nodes or intersections" (p. 93) as HC-G2's corners.

graydon-blow.label: Fronting Graydon Avenue or Blow Street (Jason's addition)
graydon-blow.how: The parcel comes within 45 ft of Graydon Avenue's or Blow Street's centerline. Both are classed residential.

mix.source: Policy Brief No. 2 (Ghent Streets), Section III: "50% food/beverage (cafés and restaurants), 30% retail goods, 20% personal/professional services. This mix is an assumption." The split within each is ours.
